sources.finding: The examined LoopRewriter clones the body for each iteration. Merely replacing our expansion with an OpenVINO Loop is not established to eliminate NPU graph expansion.
The documented optimization-level=0 mode may reduce compile work; not exercised in these tests.

Custom SHAVE C kernels are a separate possible route. Upstream claims verification on Meteor Lake NPU3720 and documents newer generations as porting hypotheses. No custom kernel or patched NPU binary was executed on Delta; Panther Lake compatibility is unproven.
